translations.web: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
translations.bsb: The spiritual man judges all things, but he himself is not subject to anyone’s judgment.
translations.kjv: But he that is spiritual judgeth all things, yet he himself is judged of no man.
